note: Moshi (third-party SSH / mosh app) in the control registry (build full-api-cli-control-of-everything-plus-an-offli, s14): only what Moshi publishes is registered: its launcher intent and the moshi://tmux and moshi://herdr deep links that resume an active session card (https://getmoshi.app/docs/notifications (Open active sessions with deep links; Moshi 3.9.3+, pane and tab 3.13.0+)). entries.label: Moshi
entries.description: Moshi, the third-party mosh / SSH terminal on Brett's phone (Android app.getmoshi.android; axHub's handoff copies a ready claude command for it). Controllable only through what Moshi publishes: its launcher and two deep links that resume an already active tmux or Herdr session card. Source: https://getmoshi.app/docs/notifications (Open active sessions with deep links; Moshi 3.9.3+, pane and tab 3.13.0+).

gaps.why: opening a host or a new connection: Moshi publishes no link or intent for it (its deep links never create a connection from a saved one)
gaps.plan: none: Moshi is a third-party app; only what its docs publish is registered (docs/integrations/moshi.md)

gaps.why: running a command, sending keys or typing into a session: not exposed by Moshi
gaps.plan: none: Moshi is a third-party app; only what its docs publish is registered (docs/integrations/moshi.md)

gaps.why: what Moshi shows (connections, cards, sessions): Moshi exposes no state read; tmux / Herdr state is read on the host (vps/tool/processes, vps/tool/logs)
gaps.plan: none: Moshi is a third-party app; only what its docs publish is registered (docs/integrations/moshi.md)

gaps.why: Moshi's settings (keys, hooks, notifications, look): changed only inside Moshi
gaps.plan: none: Moshi is a third-party app; only what its docs publish is registered (docs/integrations/moshi.md)

gaps.why: Moshi runs on the phone with no API: REST and MCP answer the link to open (a handoff), they cannot press anything in Moshi
gaps.plan: none: Moshi is a third-party app; only what its docs publish is registered (docs/integrations/moshi.md)

entries.label: Moshi tmux session
entries.description: Resume an active or minimized tmux session card in Moshi (moshi://tmux). It never opens a new connection: no matching card = Moshi shows an error.

actions.label: Resume a tmux session in Moshi

params.name: window
params.description: window index 0-9 (sends the tmux prefix and the digit)

params.name: pane
params.description: stable pane id (#{pane_id}, e.g. %5 or 5); Moshi 3.13.0+

entries.label: Moshi Herdr session
entries.description: Resume an active Herdr session card in Moshi (moshi://herdr), optionally on a workspace, tab and pane. It never opens a new session or connection.

actions.label: Resume a Herdr session in Moshi

params.name: session
params.description: the Herdr server session (herdr session list)
